lines.say: M R P easy versus Katana. Not the same job.
lines.show: MRPeasy vs Katana. Not the same job.

lines.say: M R P easy is a manufacturing E R P. Planning, C R M and accounts, in every plan.
lines.show: MRPeasy is a manufacturing ERP. Planning, CRM and accounts in every plan.

lines.say: Katana is cloud inventory software for product businesses. Production is one part of it.
lines.show: Katana is cloud inventory software for product businesses. Production is one part of it.

lines.say: They charge in opposite ways. M R P easy is per user, per month, on four plans.
lines.show: They charge in opposite ways. MRPeasy: per user, per month, on four plans.

lines.say: Katana is free up to thirty S K U's. After that, one annual price, not per user.
lines.show: Katana: free up to 30 SKUs. After that, one annual price, not per user.

lines.say: And raw materials count as S K U's too.
lines.show: And raw materials count as SKUs too.

lines.say: Both connect to Xero and QuickBooks Online. Neither lists M Y O B.
lines.show: Both connect to Xero and QuickBooks Online. Neither lists MYOB.

lines.say: Hard part is planning? M R P easy. Selling online? Katana.
lines.show: Hard part is planning? MRPeasy. Selling online? Katana.
